outcome.Summary: Created semver/semver.go implementing SemVer 2.0.0: Version struct (Major/Minor/Patch uint64, Pre/Build []string), Parse (optional leading "v", rejects wrong part counts, non-digits, leading zeros in numeric fields and numeric pre-release ids, empty identifiers, and characters outside [0-9A-Za-z-]), String (canonical form without "v"), Compare (numeric core comparison; pre-release < release; left-to-right identifier comparison with numeric vs alphanumeric rules; shorter list lower; build metadata ignored), and MustParse (panics on error). Added semver/semver_test.go covering valid/invalid parsing, String round-trips, core and pre-release precedence (including the spec's section-11 ordered list), numeric-vs-alphanumeric cases, build-metadata insensitivity, and MustParse panic behavior. Verified with `go test ./... -count=1` (pass), `go vet`, and `gofmt -l` (clean).
